decisions.reason: The mitred lever family is still listed in 2024 and fits FSB's coordinated design families, so the firm can carry it with its slack despite little visible evidence of success.
Moving from a mention to its own page in 2024 signals rising internal commitment and performance meeting aspirations, and it supports the firm's multifunctional and barrier-free direction.
It is still mentioned but has gained no prominence, so its results are uncertain, yet at low carrying cost a design-led firm is likely to keep it for at least another year.
The FSB 1289 collection won both the German Design Award and the iF Design Award and has its own page, clearly exceeding aspirations and making it a flagship to retain.
